title: Molecular characterization of Satsuma mandarin (Citrus unshiu Marc.) VASCULAR PLANT ONE-ZINC FINGER2 (CuVOZ2) interacting with CuFT1 and CuFT3.
authors: Hasan, Nazmul; Tokuhara, Naoki; Noda, Takayuki; Kotoda, Nobuhiro
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柑橘CuVOZ2转录因子与FT蛋白的互作及开花调控，虽涉及TF和蛋白互作，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，仅含简单对接模拟，缺乏AI或MD方法，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Shortening the juvenility is a burning issue in breeding fruit trees such as Satsuma mandarin (Citrus unshiu Marc.). Decreasing the breeding period requires a comprehensive understanding of the flowering process in woody plants. Throughout the Arabidopsis flowering system, FLOWERING LOCUS T (FT) interacts with other transcription factors (TFs) and functions as a transmissible floral inducer. In a previous study, a VASCULAR PLANT ONE-ZINC FINGER1 (VOZ1)-like TF from the Satsuma mandarin, CuVOZ1, showed protein-protein interaction with two citrus FTs in a yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) system and precocious flowering in Arabidopsis. In this study, another VOZ, CuVOZ2, was isolated from the Satsuma mandarin 'Aoshima' and protein-protein interaction was confirmed between CuVOZ2 and CuFTs. No apical meristem (NAM) and zinc coordination motifs were identified within the N-terminal of CuVOZ2. Docking simulation predicted that interactions between CuVOZ2 and CuFTs might occur in domain B of CuVOZ2, which contains a zinc finger motif. According to docking predictions, the distances between the amino acid residues involved ranged from 1.09 to 4.37 A, indicating weak Van der Waals forces in the interaction. Cys216, Cys221, Cys235, and His239 in CuVOZ2 were suggested to bond with a Zn(2+) in the Zn coordination motif. Ectopic expression of 35SOmega:CuVOZ2 in Arabidopsis affected the flowering time, length of inflorescence and internode, and number of siliques, suggesting that CuVOZ2 might regulate both vegetative and reproductive development, act as a trigger for early flowering, and be involved in the elongation of inflorescence possibly in a slightly different way than CuVOZ1.
abstract_zh: 缩短童期是柑橘类果树（如温州蜜柑 (Citrus unshiu Marc.)）育种中的一个紧迫问题。缩短育种周期需要全面了解木本植物的开花过程。在拟南芥开花系统中，FLOWERING LOCUS T (FT) 与其他转录因子 (TFs) 相互作用，并作为可传递的花诱导因子发挥作用。在先前的研究中，来自温州蜜柑的VASCULAR PLANT ONE-ZINC FINGER1 (VOZ1) 类转录因子 CuVOZ1，在酵母双杂交 (Y2H) 系统中与两个柑橘FTs表现出蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，并在拟南芥中诱导早花。在本研究中，从温州蜜柑‘Aoshima’中分离出另一个VOZ，即CuVOZ2，并确认了CuVOZ2与CuFTs之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。在CuVOZ2的N端未鉴定出顶端分生组织 (NAM) 和锌配位基序。对接模拟预测，CuVOZ2与CuFTs之间的相互作用可能发生在CuVOZ2的B结构域，该结构域包含一个锌指基序。根据对接预测，涉及的氨基酸残基之间的距离范围为1.09至4.37 Å，表明相互作用中存在弱的范德华力。CuVOZ2中的Cys216、Cys221、Cys235和His239被建议与锌配位基序中的Zn(2+)结合。35SOmega:CuVOZ2在拟南芥中的异位表达影响了开花时间、花序和节间长度以及角果数量，表明CuVOZ2可能调控营养和生殖发育，作为早花的触发因子，并可能以与CuVOZ1略有不同的方式参与花序伸长。
